summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY with embedded software experience in bare-metal C and C++ on STM32 and Arduino microcontrollers, FreeRTOS real-time tasks, and UART/I2C/SPI serial interfaces. Built Python tools for real-time data acquisition and hardware bring-up, and debugged hardware/software integration failures with logic analyzers and oscilloscopes.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth, translating 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built Cortex-M4 temperature monitoring firmware in embedded C at a deterministic 1 Hz update rate using only 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM; verified in Proteus.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver.
Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1).

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided pick-and-place system over a Flask-SocketIO edge server and Jetson+Arduino controller; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).

Resolved 11 hardware/software integration failures (servo brown-out, false-positive detections, stale-frame capture); added dual VL53L0X ToF sensors over a TCA9548A I2C mux for contact-aware grasping.
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++ driving five servos with range-gated contact detection.
Deployed the Jetson arm bridge as a systemd service (auto-restart with backoff, non-root isolation) with static IP networking.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination on STM32, integrating VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override; YOLOv8 on Jetson sent control commands to the STM32 over UART.

projects.name: Robocon Competition Robot — Encoder Odometry & Motor Control
bullets: Implemented interrupt-driven quadrature decoding (2400 CPR) as a 4-bit A/B transition state machine on Arduino Due; fed heading error into 15 kHz PWM closed-loop correction across four motor channels.
Added a fail-safe state machine halting all motors on controller disconnect; integrated Xbox 360 control over USB Host Shield with 4x Cytron motor drivers.
